screen.entitytracker.title: Entity Container Tracker
screen.entitytracker.area.title: Mark area as destroyed
screen.entitytracker.area.entities: Entities (%s) - by home area, tap to untick
screen.entitytracker.area.done: Moved %s containers to the trash. /etracker undo to restore them.
screen.entitytracker.delete_confirm_body: %s will be forgotten for good. This cannot be undone.
screen.entitytracker.reappeared: %s was seen again and restored from the trash.
screen.entitytracker.warn.container_chan: container changed, open it to update
screen.entitytracker.hint.over_hopper: over a hopper, may be drained
screen.entitytracker.explain._comment: Explanations shown when you hover a status or note (or tap Show warnings). Edit freely; an empty or missing entry shows no explanation, and a resource pack can fill it in.
screen.entitytracker.explain.status.load: It's loaded near you right now.
screen.entitytracker.explain.status.miss: You're close to where it should be, but it isn't there. It may have wandered off or been moved, been killed or broken while you were away, or gone through a portal. The tracker can't tell which. Confirm it is not there before marking it as destroyed.
screen.entitytracker.explain.status.like: It probably died or was destroyed. Double-check before marking it as destroyed.
screen.entitytracker.explain.went_throug: It vanished next to a portal, so it most likely went through. The tracker can't see the other side and isn't sure it survived.
screen.entitytracker.explain.chest_remov: This donkey was seen without its chest. Taking a chest off a donkey drops everything in it, so the remembered contents are probably gone.
screen.entitytracker.explain.container_c: A different kind of container now stands here. The old contents are kept until you open it again.
screen.entitytracker.explain.reappeared: It was thought destroyed (or was in the trash) but has been seen alive again.
screen.entitytracker.explain.hopper_belo: A hopper underneath can pull items out of it over time.
screen.entitytracker.explain.fed_by_hopp: A hopper points into it and can add items over time.
screen.entitytracker.explain.processes_i: Furnaces and brewing stands change their own contents as they smelt or brew.
screen.entitytracker.explain.moves_items: Hoppers and hopper minecarts pull in and pass on items by themselves.
screen.entitytracker.explain.over_hopper: This minecart sits on a rail above a hopper, which can empty it.
screen.entitytracker.explain.stale: You haven't opened it during your last %s days on this server. Not a warning: another player, or something in the game like a hopper, may have changed the contents while you were gone. Days you weren't on this server don't count.
screen.entitytracker.explain.in_trash: You marked it destroyed. It's hidden from search and will be forgotten after %s days unless you restore it.
screen.entitytracker.bulk.delete_body: They will be forgotten for good. This cannot be undone.
